name: Fresh Canna | 1g Live Resin | Melonade
description: Refresh your senses with Fresh Canna’s Live Resin Wax – Melonade, a zesty, fruit-forward sativa that delivers an electrifying burst of flavor and energy. Made from fresh-frozen cannabis, this live resin wax captures the full essence of its terpene-rich profile, ensuring a smooth, flavorful, and invigorating experience with every dab. With juicy watermelon, tart lemon, and subtle herbal undertones, Melonade delivers a bright and uplifting high, perfect for boosting creativity, motivation, and mood. Whether you're tackling a project or just vibing through the day, this energizing strain keeps you fresh, focused, and feeling fantastic.
